historical_record.description: By a 4-2 vote the City Planning Commission upheld the negative declaration for a proposed 22-unit, four-building apartment project at 120 Corwin Street, finding it could not have a significant environmental effect.

The 120 Corwin Street site was vacant land beside the Seward Street mini-park, with Acme Alley along one side. After discretionary review, the City Planning Commission unanimously approved the revised building permit application for 22 dwelling units in four buildings at 120 Corwin Street, on two conditions: reduce roof-deck overhangs to keep sun on the mini-park, and staff review of final materials and landscaping.
